# codex-swarm v0.8.2

This follow-up patch makes Windows uninstall resilient when PATH cleanup cannot
run.

## Fixed

- Uninstall treats removal of its managed user `PATH` entry as best effort. If
  `cs.exe` is missing or blocked, it records the failure and still removes the
  application files and Installed Apps registration.
- Installer smoke coverage now verifies that long `REG_EXPAND_SZ` PATH values
  retain both their exact content and registry type through install, reinstall,
  and uninstall.
- Release history now records the previously shipped v0.8.0 Linux user-service
  release.
